articles.summary: First U.K. case series demonstrates successful use of RECELL GO ® in 17 burn and reconstructive surgery patients Findings presented at the British Burn Association Annual Meeting support the role of RECELL GO in standardizing preparation of RECELL ® Spray-On Skin™ Cells and improving operating room
